versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If the recpetion of PN shutdown message via call- back function Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown is indicated, then Nm shall stop the ERA related monitoring of external PNC requests of the PNCs (see [SWS_Nm_00324])) which are indicated for an PNC shutdown (PNC bit set to '1') in the given PNC bit vector and forward the indication to ComM with the correspond- ing ComMChannel by calling ComM_Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown( <ComMChannel>, <PncBitVector>) .

If the reception of PN shutdown message via callback function Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown is indicated, then Nm shall stop the ERA related monitoring of external PNC requests of the PNCs (see [SWS_Nm_00324])) which are indicated for an PNC shutdown (PNC bit set to '1') in the given PNC bit vector , set the corresponding ERA bits to '0' in the ERA of the indicated NM-channel and forward the indication to ComM with the corresponding ComMChan- nel by calling ComM_Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown(<ComMChannel>, <PncBitVector>) .
